_comment: Shared price cases. Used by SITE test/money.test.js (JS parseEuroToCents) and by the function repo python cents() test (tools/build-catalogue.py). Strings only. 'valid' = both parsers must return the same cents. 'reject' = both must reject (JS: null, python: ValueError). 'differ' = intentionally different: JS (browser display parser) is more lenient than python (strict build-time parser, which also lets 0 through because the >= 50 cents rule is enforced separately).

differ.note: JS reads 1.234 as 1234 EUR (3 digits = thousands); python rejects (max 2 decimals)
JS rejects 0; python returns 0 and the generator rejects it later (priceCents >= 50)
JS caps at 1e7 cents; python caps later in the catalogue schema test
